statements.statement: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "pgcrypto";
CREATE SEQUENCE "seq_focus_session_session_no";
CREATE TABLE "comment" ("body" text NOT NULL, "id" uuid NOT NULL, "target_id" uuid NOT NULL, "target_type" varchar(64) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "pk_comment" PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE "focus_session" ("focus_task_id" uuid NOT NULL, "id" uuid NOT NULL, "minutes" bigint NOT NULL, "session_no" bigint DEFAULT nextval('seq_focus_session_session_no') NOT NULL, "started_at" timestamptz NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "pk_focus_session" PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE "tag" ("color" varchar(64), "id" uuid NOT NULL, "label" varchar(64) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "pk_tag" PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CONSTRAINT "chk_tag_color" CHECK ("color" IN ('blue', 'green', 'red')));

CREATE TABLE "task" ("created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL, "deleted_at" timestamptz, "due_date" date, "id" uuid NOT NULL, "minutes" bigint DEFAULT 0, "note" text, "parent_task_id" uuid, "row_etag" bytea NOT NULL, "status" varchar(16) NOT NULL, "tenant_id" uuid NOT NULL, "title" varchar(200) NOT NULL, "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "pk_task" PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CONSTRAINT "chk_task_window" CHECK ("deleted_at" IS NULL));
CREATE TABLE "task_detail" ("description" text, "id" uuid NOT NULL, "task_id" uuid NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "pk_task_detail" PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE "task_external_link" ("external_key" varchar(255) NOT NULL, "id" uuid NOT NULL, "provider" varchar(64) NOT NULL, "task_id" uuid NOT NULL, "url" text, CONSTRAINT "pk_task_external_link" PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE "task_roster" ("id" uuid NOT NULL, "members" varchar(64)[], CONSTRAINT "pk_task_roster" PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE "task_tag" ("task_id" uuid NOT NULL, "tag_id" uuid NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT "pk_task_tag" PRIMARY KEY ("task_id", "tag_id"));
ALTER TABLE "focus_session" ADD CONSTRAINT "fk_focus_session_focus_task_id" FOREIGN KEY ("focus_task_id") REFERENCES "task"("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT;
ALTER TABLE "task" ADD CONSTRAINT "fk_task_parent_task_id" FOREIGN KEY ("parent_task_id") REFERENCES "task"("id") ON DELETE SET NULL;
ALTER TABLE "task_detail" ADD CONSTRAINT "fk_task_detail_task_id" FOREIGN KEY ("task_id") REFERENCES "task"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE;
ALTER TABLE "task_external_link" ADD CONSTRAINT "fk_task_external_link_task_id" FOREIGN KEY ("task_id") REFERENCES "task"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE;
ALTER TABLE "task_tag" ADD CONSTRAINT "fk_task_tag_task_id" FOREIGN KEY ("task_id") REFERENCES "task"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE;
ALTER TABLE "task_tag" ADD CONSTRAINT "fk_task_tag_tag_id" FOREIGN KEY ("tag_id") REFERENCES "tag"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "idx_tag_label_uq" ON "tag" ("label");
CREATE INDEX "idx_task_due_date" ON "task" ("due_date");
CREATE INDEX "idx_task_due_open" ON "task" ("due_date") WHERE "deleted_at" IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX "idx_task_tenant" ON "task" ("tenant_id");
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "idx_task_detail_task_id_uq" ON "task_detail" ("task_id");
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "uq_external_identity" ON "task_external_link" ("provider", "external_key");
ALTER SEQUENCE "seq_focus_session_session_no" OWNED BY "focus_session"."session_no";
ALTER TABLE "task" ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE "task" FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "pol_task_tenant" ON "task" USING ("tenant_id" = current_setting('app.tenant_id')::uuid);
